about_the_game:
DRIVE. SMASH. SURVIVE.

Enter the Hogtagon - a brutal vehicular battleground where only the strongest survive. In this high-octane driving sumo-inspired game, 2-8 players battle in deadly arena to be the last hog standing. You may not understand the cosmic force that summoned you to the arena, but one thought emanates through your mind - victory at all costs.

CHAOS ON WHEELS

Command powerful vehicles in a desperate struggle for dominance. Master the art of vehicular combat as you strategically ram, push, and outmaneuver your opponents, sending them flying into the abyss below. Every collision brings you closer to victory - or doom.

FEATURES IN DEMO

  • Intense Vehicular Sumo Battles: Crash, smash and bash your opponents off the arena in fast-paced matches where quick reflexes and tactical thinking determine the champion.

  • Multiple Game Modes: Play free-for-all or team-based matches with 2-8 players online.

  • Responsive Physics: Pilot your hog and experience visceral collision mechanics that make every impact feel powerful and consequential.

FEATURES IN FULL GAME

  • Additional Levels: Prove your mastery outside of the classic Hogtagon with new arenas and obstacles.

  • New Game Modes: New and customizable ways to play. Create your own rules and dictate the action.

  • Single Player and Bot Matches: Not enough friends available for the full Hogtagon experience? Add Bot players to increase the chaos, or practice your skills offline.

The Hogtagon awaits. Will you seize glory or be hurled into oblivion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-4300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or AMD Radeon R7 240 (1GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Not required for basic gameplay, but controller use is recommended

short_description: Hogtagon is an action-packed vehicular sumo game where 2-8 players crash into each other in a deadly arena - The Hogtagon. Knock opponents off the edge, be the last hog standing, and dominate in free-for-all or team-based online matches with physics that make every impact count.
